title: Battery Pass Consortium SAMM aspect models
authority: Battery Pass Consortium (published and validated via GEFEG)
usedFor: A conformance target for the battery product group — the sector with the earliest binding obligation date.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey, reporting v1.2.0 with Performance at 1.2.1.
finding: This is NOT the SAMM vocabulary already recorded in this project. `dpp-aas` tracks `urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass` — Catena-X / Eclipse Tractus-X — and this is `urn:samm:io.BatteryPass`, the Battery Pass Consortium's own. Two different aspect-model families under the same URN scheme, for the same product group, from two different organisations. Treating them as one would be a category error, and the near-identical names make it an easy one. Which of the two the EU ecosystem actually converges on is unknown here and worth more than either model's field list.
nextStep: Establish the relationship between this and the Catena-X models before mapping to either. Then compare one of them, field by field, against our battery model — that comparison is the concrete route to the missing-field gap, and it is a gap analysis, not an adoption.
